reuse.why: Adds a new getScheduleAmount beside the existing exported getScheduledAmount (which keeps the midpoint rule for desktop-client) instead of evolving that helper, though it does reuse getApproxNumberThreshold.

duplication.why: Four inline copies are replaced by the new helper, but it now duplicates the purpose of getScheduledAmount and the schedule-template copy is left in place.

placement.why: The rule sits in shared/schedules.ts and the API field in scheduleModel, the right layers.

scope.why: Focused on the requested steps; the api.ts create-type tweak is a reasonable companion edit.

maintainability.why: Two near-identically named helpers with different rules, an approximate branch keyed on a {value, op} shape no caller passes, and an unconverted template site leave the rule split across places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts (used by desktop-client SchedulesTable, Balance, mobile schedules, useScheduleEdit) and server/budget/schedule-template.ts keep their own midpoint logic instead of going through getScheduleAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: getScheduleAmount restates getScheduledAmount's missing/number/range resolution under an almost identical name rather than replacing or extending it.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduleAmount gains an isapprox branch keyed on a {value, op} input shape that none of its callers (which pass the raw _amount number) supply; getScheduledAmount and the schedule-template site bypass it.
